body.message:
Could you please confirm the following details, I want to make sure we are aligned:
- the rent will be paid on a monthly basis
- ⁠the rent price will be fixed aed 5k for first 3 months, then 6k for the next 3 months if we were to extend my stay
- ⁠deposit will be returned when I move out 
- ⁠if I were to move out, 1 month prior notice is enough
- I will have access to gym, pool and parking space
- ⁠ a contract will be shared once the deposit is done

Can I know your name please as well?
